adoption: Already approved/integrated scoped correction; this campaign measures rather than reopens adoption. Report opposing pairs; no significance claim.
correctness: pristine count1000/sum500500, independent update id1 to2, held children each sum500501, final active mappings/RW/reservation zero, empty owned scratch; controlled negative must fail and clean
fixture: 1000 rows (id,v)=(1,1)..(1000,1000), fork_probe InnoDB; TCP go-sql-driver/mysql1.9.3; read/write/purge=1/2/1 native_aio=0
host_source_commit: each pinned canonical production source; shared unchanged measurement harness
mechanism: No observer or guest instrumentation; previously established mechanism is not re-measured.
preflight_correction: No previous run receipts reused; canonical pre-merge and merge source identities are independently checked.
queue: N/A, deliberately outside this remeasurement; no new probes or old Fn-anchor reuse.
rss: same process baseline to held1/2/4 deltas; GC then500ms idle at every checkpoint; ps current RSS in KiB; closed checkpoint also measured

runs.batch: five alternating pairs at P8 and separate five pairs at P4;48 independent children per process; root/Snapshot excluded; all child closes included
runs.serial: five alternating paired fresh processes, four sequentially held children; median within process then median across five
runs.warmup: one baseline/candidate fresh process per mode, excluded

stop: no retry until performance passes; five pairs fixed; any oracle/cleanup failure stops performance assessment; missing queue means overall four-field adoption verdict INCONCLUSIVE
